items.title: Tony's daughter Molly was killed in just 59 seconds

children.content: 59 seconds. That's all it took for Daniel Billings to break into his ex-girlfriend Molly Ticehurst’s home and kill her.

Molly's father Tony misses his best mate every day. But he’s proud of his daughter’s legacy — reforms designed to make bail more difficult for accused domestic violence offenders. Friends and family are calling it “Molly’s Law”.
Australian Story reports.
